text: Lucy's dad had a fall on Sunday, broke his wrist. Fracture clinic Thursday at 10am. She's driving up from Leeds to take him. Her mum doesn't drive and is apparently fussing over him nonstop, which he hates. Lucy's trying to sort carers for a couple of weeks after. Might be worth asking her Friday how the clinic went.
Kai and Simone got engaged!! Proposed on the beach in Lisbon last weekend. Wedding probably summer 2027, nothing booked yet
text Felix tomorrow morning to see how his mum's biopsy went

Ibrahim's little girl Laila has chickenpox, he's off work all week looking after her. Wife Dalia is away in Manchester till Friday on a work course. Laila's apparently miserable and covered head to toe, keeps asking for her mum. Ibrahim sounded frazzled, said he's watched Frozen about nine times since Monday. I should drop off some colouring books or something tomorrow afternoon.
dalia - 10th wedding anniversary 14 Nov, they're doing a weekend in the Cotswolds. she mentioned she's been eyeing a Le Creuset casserole dish, could be a nice gift from the group
Sunil's knee op is on 2 November 2026 at 8am. He's quite nervous about the anaesthetic. Must ring him the evening before.
Lars has moved in with his girlfriend Camila, flat in Walthamstow. Works nights at the hospital lab so best to message him after 2pm.
Sinead told me her brother Oisín is getting married in Galway, 20 March 2027. She's maid of honour?? no wait, she's doing a reading. Anyway she's dreading the speech bit at the reception.
Pick up prescription Friday before 5, then post office.
Blessing's mum is back in hospital, pneumonia this time. Blessing sounded wrecked on the phone. Don't forget to drop round soup or something at the weekend.

Archie (Arch) is training for the Brighton half, race is Sunday 12 April 2027. Running five mornings a week, says his shins are killing him. Physio told him to cut back but he won't listen. He's raising money for the stroke charity because of his mum, page is on his Insta. Sponsor him before payday on the 25th.
Emeka and Chloe's anniversary dinner on Saturday got cancelled, Chloe's got norovirus. Rescheduled to the 7th at half 7 apparently.
omar's son Jamal broke his collarbone at rugby yday. surgery not needed thank god. off school 2 wks

Dimitri said his wife Dorota is expecting, due March 2027. Their second. Dorota's had awful morning sickness so they've kept it quiet till now. I should send them something small. Their eldest Kai is four and apparently thrilled about being a big brother. Dimitri also said he's switching to part time at the firm from January 2027 so he can do more at home.
Aleksander loves vinyl, collects old jazz pressings. Mentioned wanting a Blue Note reissue of Kind of Blue
Naledi's grandad passed away on Tuesday night. Funeral is next Wednesday at 11am at St Mary's. Need to sort a card and ask if she wants a lift.
Yetunde got the all clear from her scan this morning!! Massive relief. Send congrats and flowers
Julia - vegetarian, allergic to tree nuts. Her husband Bruno is coeliac. Remember for the dinner on the 30th.

ok so voice note. Just had coffee with Ines, she's been off sick for nearly a month with long covid. Says the fatigue is the worst bit, can barely do the school run some days. Her partner Tiago has gone down to four days a week to help out with their kids. She's got another appointment with the respiratory consultant on Monday the 9th at 2:15. I want to check in with her after that, maybe Tuesday evening. Also she said she misses the book club so maybe I could drop the next book round.
Imani and Tendai's wedding is booked! 5 September 2027, Leeds Castle. Save the dates coming in the new year.
Jasmine's dog Pepper had an operation on her leg yesterday afternoon, ligament thing. Jasmine was in bits. ask her how Pepper's doing at the weekend

Lucy said her brother Kai has been signed off with stress. Not telling the family much. She's worried about him. He's been off since the start of October and his wife Naledi is holding everything together with the kids. Lucy asked me not to mention it but thinks he'd appreciate a pint. Maybe ask Kai out next week, keep it casual.
Felix and his partner celebrate 25 years on 18 December. Big party planned at the cricket club, Saturday 19th from 7pm. I'm doing the playlist.
dentist tues 9:40, car MOT the 28th at 8. dont forget
Ibrahim Ahmed - new neighbour at no. 14. Teaches maths at the comp. Two kids, oldest is about 9.

Sunil's dad has early dementia, diagnosed last spring. Sunil's going up to Birmingham every other weekend now. Sounds exhausted, poor guy. His brother lives in Dubai so it's all falling on Sunil and his mum. They've got a meeting with a memory clinic on 17 November at 9am. Worth checking in with him after that, maybe the weekend after.
Call Camila Thursday after 6 re her mum's hip replacement, should be home by then
Lars proposed to Camila on her birthday!! She said yes obvs. Engagement drinks Friday 6 Nov at the Crown, 8pm onwards.
Wedding fair with Sinead on Saturday at 11. She wants a second opinion on venues before her and Oisín's mum go to Kilkenny.
Blessing Murphy aka Bee. Starts as practice nurse at the Elm Road surgery in January 2027. Currently on the wards at St Thomas'.

So Archie's mum had a mini stroke last week, she's in Royal Free. He was really shaken talking about it, kept saying she's always been the healthy one. Discharge maybe Friday. His sister Simone is flying back from Toronto tomorrow night to help. I need to message him tomorrow evening, and maybe offer to walk the dog while he's at the hospital, his spaniel Biscuit.
emeka's wife's 40th is 3 Dec, he wants ideas. she's into pottery + gardening. said a wheel-throwing class would go down well
Chloe's been off all week with tonsillitis, voice gone. Fine to text but not call
omar had his hernia op this morning at 7.30, all went fine apparently. home tomorrow. Remind me to check on him at the weekend.
Dorota & Dimitri renewing their vows in Kraków in August 2027 for their 15th. They've invited us, need to say yes by end of Jan.
Aleksander's knee is still bad from the ski trip in Feb. Physio twice a week. Hates swimming but it's the only thing he's allowed to do.
naledi's sis Yetunde?? no — Naledi's cousin is Yetunde, didn't know that. small world. both from Durban originally
Julia's daughter's first communion is Sunday 15th at 10.30. Julia's mum and dad flying in from Porto on the Wednesday.
Bruno Santos - plays bass in a covers band. Gig at the Old Bell Friday the 13th at 9pm. Said I'd go.
Ines is so anxious about her smear results, should come back next week. Must text her Thursday morning.
Gym 6am tomorrow, then food shop. Haircut Saturday at half 10.
Imani's brother Jamal has glandular fever. Mid-uni exams too, she's worried he'll fail the year.
Tiago and Ines married 10 years on the 22nd. Tiago planning a surprise trip to Madeira, flights booked for the 21st at 6am. Don't mention it to Ines!!
Tendai's son started reception in September, has been poorly nonstop since. Ear infections mostly. Tendai has an appointment with the GP Monday at 4.
Jasmine Barros - met at the antenatal class. Due a week after us, early Feb 2027. Husband Felix is a firefighter.
Kai's stag do is in Dublin, 13-15 November 2026. Need to transfer the £180 to Lucy by Friday.
Dalia mentioned her dad is having a heart bypass in the new year, January 2027 probably. She's trying to be positive but she's scared. Ibrahim's taking time off to drive her down.
Simone and Archie's mum turned 70 last Saturday, big lunch at the Ivy. Archie said she got loads of orchids. Ask Simone how the speech went
rang Sunil re his knee - recovering well, walking with one crutch now. back at work 30 Nov.
Lars' grandma Dorota passed away Sunday morning, 94. He was very close to her. Funeral in Oslo, he flies out Thursday at 7am.
Remember Laila loves anything unicorn and is turning 6 on 11 Jan.

Long call with Camila tonight. Her and Lars have set a date — 2 October 2027, at her parents' farm outside Valencia. Her mum is already in full planning mode, which Camila finds a bit much. Lars' brother Aleksander will be best man. They're thinking a small civil thing in London first, maybe March. She asked if I'd do a reading, said yes. Need to look at flights to Valencia before prices go up.
Oisín's girlfriend Julia broke her ankle hiking in Snowdonia. Cast for six weeks, can't drive. He's doing all the school runs.
Chloe Banerjee is godmother to Emeka's twins. Christening was postponed, now Sunday 24 Jan 2027 at 1pm.
felt rubbish all day. early night
Omar and Blessing's engagement party is off, they've split up. Omar's staying at his brother's for now. Should invite him round for dinner next week.
Naledi's partner Jasmine is having IVF, egg collection Wednesday morning. Naledi's taking the day off. Text Naledi Wednesday at lunchtime.
Archie hates coriander and anything spicy. Loves a Sunday roast. Supports Spurs, poor man.
Dimitri's mum Ines has shingles, really painful. He's been doing her shopping after work every evening this week.

Yetunde mentioned her parents' ruby anniversary is 4 December 2026. She and her brother Emeka are throwing them a surprise party on Saturday the 5th at 3pm at their church hall. Yetunde is in charge of the cake and is panicking a bit. Offered to help with decorations. She said her mum would love a photo album of the 40 years, so maybe I can chip in for that. Remind me to ask Emeka for the old photos by mid November.
